definitions.gloss: to jump up and down; to hop; to bounce around
definitions.explanation: To make repeated jumping or hopping movements, typically expressing excitement, joy, or energetic movement.
For liquid or small particles to jump or fly up, as when something is dropped into water or when cooking oil splatters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねている。
⟦うさぎ→兎：01854_usagi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{野原|のはら}→野原：14417_nohara⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねている。
examples.english: A rabbit is hopping around in the field.

examples.japanese: ⟦{合格|ごうかく}→合格：02816_goukaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{知|し}って→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦{嬉|うれ}しくて→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねた。
examples.english: When I found out I passed, I jumped for joy.

⟦{水|みず}たまり→水たまり：19427_mizutamari⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{水|みず}→水：02258_mizu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねて⟦{靴|くつ}→靴：00725_kutsu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{濡|ぬ}れた→濡れる：00800_nureru⟧。
examples.english: Water splashed up from a puddle and got my shoes wet.

examples.english: Oil from the frying pan splattered onto my clothes.

notes:
FORMS:
Compound verb: ⟦{飛|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ (to jump/fly) + ⟦{跳|は}ねる→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧ (to leap/splash).
The combination emphasizes lively, repeated jumping movements.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{嬉|うれ}しくて→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to jump for joy
- ⟦ピョンピョン→ぴょんぴょん：28488_pyonpyon⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to hop around
- ⟦{元気|げんき}→元気：00696_genki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{飛|と}び{跳|は}ねる - to bounce around energetically

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{跳|は}ねる→跳ねる：04378_haneru⟧ - to jump; to splash (a single movement)
- ⟦ぴょんぴょん→ぴょんぴょん：28488_pyonpyon⟧⟦{跳|と}ぶ→飛ぶ：00759_tobu⟧ - to hop (onomatopoeic)
